title: MV Lock certain characters in the formation options from being moved?

posts.author: RedAce4152
posts.body: Hi! Im somewhat new to RPG Maker and am currently making a test game, but I dont want the main character to be able to be swapped around in and out of the team. This could also be useful in my big project where maybe you HAVE to get stuck with a bad character or some sort of curse. Does such a plugin exist? Thank you in advance

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Yanfly has Party System plugin with lock actors.

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: The native engine is just all or nothing. I haven't used the plugin mentioned above but it sounds like just the thing.
